title: TriOS portable local landing of the zai-provider integration stack
problem: The feat/zai-provider branch contained ~200 modified/untracked files spanning TriOS Swift rings, BrowserOS server changes, generated docs, build products, and runtime state. A safe local landing on dev required triaging the dirty tree, fixing pre-commit lint errors, running all Trinity gates, and documenting the remaining clean-machine blockers honestly.
root_cause: Multiple cycles of autonomous work (Cycles 10-27) accumulated source, plans, generated artifacts, and runtime state in the same working tree. The stale task claim was held by codex-root with no TTL, blocking legal mutation under Trinity coordination law. The lefthook pre-commit gate then surfaced 8 Biome errors that had to be fixed before the integration commit could land.
fix: Reclaimed the stale codex-root claim and created a new claude claim with TTL and P1 priority.
Classified files into buckets A (core source), B (plans/reports), C (generated docs), and D (runtime state).
Moved bucket C to .claude/drafts/portable-land-artifacts/ and added bucket D paths to root .gitignore.
Fixed 8 hard Biome errors in packages/browseros-agent/apps/server: unused variables/imports, redeclared types, node:crypto import, any types, and JSON formatting.
Committed 218 files as a single integration commit and fast-forwarded local dev to 0ffca73e1.
Wrote TRIOS_RELEASE_MANIFEST.md and trios/docs/INSTALLATION_README.md documenting exact commits, blockers, install steps, and first-launch guidance.
Ran the full Trinity verification contract: build.sh, clade-build, clade-e2e, clade-audit (0 findings), clade-seal (SEAL VALID), chat SSE e2e, trios e2e flow, and health check.
variants: A — Minimal: polish docs and local installer only, do not resolve publication blockers.
B — Balanced (recommended): publication runbook + push QueenUILib integration and trios-mesh submodule to reachable branches + CI clean-clone gate.
C — Deep: full clean-machine release with Developer ID signing, notarization, signed .dmg/.zip, GitHub Releases, and verification on a fresh Mac.
blockers: Unpublished QueenUILib integration in local Trinity checkout (~/trinity).
trios-mesh submodule commit 27a76f2 is local-only (feat/trios-integration branch).
Ad-hoc code signing only; Developer ID + notarization required for public release.
No signed release artifact, GitHub Release, or Homebrew cask.
learnings: Dirty-tree triage before staging is essential when many autonomous cycles have mixed source with generated/runtime files.
Run Biome directly in addition to lefthook to get stable, copy-pasteable diagnostics.
Fast-forward merge keeps history linear and avoids merge bubbles.
After ./build.sh, always relaunch trios.app with open trios.app to preserve the menu-bar logo invariant.
clade-audit and clade-seal are long-running; avoid concurrent runs that contend for the Cargo package cache lock.
next_task: Address the user-reported chat failure: model claude-opus-4-6 is unavailable / insufficient balance; /doctor reports model access issue.

follow_up.detail: origin/dev advanced 17 commits removing trios/ and apps/server/; local dev is 12 ahead, 17 behind. feat/zai-provider recreated from origin/dev.
